-- | Get the SPDX license identifier. If the license is <a>Custom</a>,
--   return the original string.
licenseId :: License -> String

-- | Parse a SPDX license identifier. If the identifier is not known,
--   return <a>Custom</a> with the original string.
parseLicense :: String -> License

-- | Package details returned by <a>getPackageDetails</a>.
data PackageInformation
PackageInformation :: Text -> Text -> Repo -> Arch -> Text -> Text -> Int -> Text -> Text -> Text -> Int -> Int -> UTCTime -> UTCTime -> Maybe UTCTime -> [Text] -> Text -> [Text] -> [License] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> PackageInformation
[_pkgname] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_pkgbase] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_repo] :: PackageInformation -> Repo
[_arch] :: PackageInformation -> Arch
[_pkgver] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_pkgrel] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_epoch] :: PackageInformation -> Int
[_pkgdesc] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_url] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_filename] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_compressedSize] :: PackageInformation -> Int
[_installedSize] :: PackageInformation -> Int
[_buildDate] :: PackageInformation -> UTCTime
[_lastUpdate] :: PackageInformation -> UTCTime
[_flageDate] :: PackageInformation -> Maybe UTCTime
[_maintainers] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_packager] :: PackageInformation -> Text
[_groups] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_licenses] :: PackageInformation -> [License]
[_conflicts] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_provides] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_replaces] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_depends] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_optdepends] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_makedepends] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]
[_checkdepends] :: PackageInformation -> [Text]

-- | Package files list returned by <a>getPackageFiles</a>
data PackageFiles
PackageFiles :: Text -> Repo -> Arch -> UTCTime -> UTCTime -> Int -> Int -> [FilePath] -> PackageFiles
[_pkgname] :: PackageFiles -> Text
[_repo] :: PackageFiles -> Repo
[_arch] :: PackageFiles -> Arch
[_pkgLastUpdate] :: PackageFiles -> UTCTime
[_filesLastUpdate] :: PackageFiles -> UTCTime
[_filesCount] :: PackageFiles -> Int
[_dirCount] :: PackageFiles -> Int
[_files] :: PackageFiles -> [FilePath]

-- | Flagged package means out-of-date.
data Flagged
Flagged :: Flagged
NotFlagged :: Flagged

-- | Response data type of <a>searchPackage</a>.
data ArchLinuxResponse a
ArchLinuxResponse :: Int -> Int -> Bool -> [a] -> ArchLinuxResponse a
[_version] :: ArchLinuxResponse a -> Int
[_limit] :: ArchLinuxResponse a -> Int
[_valid] :: ArchLinuxResponse a -> Bool
[_results] :: ArchLinuxResponse a -> [a]

-- | Search results returned by <a>searchAur</a>.
--   
--   Some of fields are renamed in this record type, for sharing overloaded
--   lenses between data type returned by Arch Linux official API.
data AurSearch
AurSearch :: Int -> Text -> Int -> Text -> Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Int -> Double -> Maybe Int -> Maybe Text -> Int -> Int -> Text -> AurSearch
[_id] :: AurSearch -> Int
[_name] :: AurSearch -> Text
[_packageBaseID] :: AurSearch -> Int
[_packageBase] :: AurSearch -> Text
[_version] :: AurSearch -> Text
[_description] :: AurSearch -> Maybe Text

-- | URL
[_url] :: AurSearch -> Maybe Text
[_numVotes] :: AurSearch -> Int
[_popularity] :: AurSearch -> Double

-- | UTCTime
[_outOfDate] :: AurSearch -> Maybe Int
[_maintainer] :: AurSearch -> Maybe Text

-- | UTCTime
[_firstSubmitted] :: AurSearch -> Int

-- | UTCTime
[_lastModified] :: AurSearch -> Int
[_urlPath] :: AurSearch -> Text

-- | Package details returned by <a>getAurInfo</a>.
--   
--   This data type extends <a>AurSearch</a> informally, so it includes
--   <a>_search</a> as a member.
data AurInfo
AurInfo :: AurSearch -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [Text] -> [License] -> [Text] -> AurInfo

-- | ID, Name, PackageBaseID, ...
[_search] :: AurInfo -> AurSearch

-- | Depends
[_depends] :: AurInfo -> [Text]

-- | MakeDepends
[_makedepends] :: AurInfo -> [Text]

-- | OptDepends
[_optdepends] :: AurInfo -> [Text]

-- | CheckDepends
[_checkdepends] :: AurInfo -> [Text]
[_conflicts] :: AurInfo -> [Text]
[_provides] :: AurInfo -> [Text]
[_replaces] :: AurInfo -> [Text]
[_groups] :: AurInfo -> [Text]
[_licenses] :: AurInfo -> [License]
[_keywords] :: AurInfo -> [Text]

-- | Return types of AUR API.
data AurResponseType
Search :: AurResponseType
Multiinfo :: AurResponseType
Error :: AurResponseType

-- | Response data type of AUR API.
data AurResponse a
AurResponse :: Int -> AurResponseType -> Int -> a -> Maybe Text -> AurResponse a
[_version] :: AurResponse a -> Int

-- | type
[_aurType] :: AurResponse a -> AurResponseType

-- | resultcount
[_resultCount] :: AurResponse a -> Int
[_results] :: AurResponse a -> a

-- | Available when <tt>aurType</tt> equals to <a>Error</a>.
[_error] :: AurResponse a -> Maybe Text

-- | Arch Linux official repositories APIs and AUR APIs.
--   
--   These two kinds of APIs are distinguished by <a>APIClient</a>.
--   Functions over them return <a>APIClient</a> parametrize by
--   corresponding <a>APIType</a>.
--   
--   Overall, there are five APIs available, refer to
--   <a>https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/Official_repositories_web_interface</a>
--   and <a>https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/Aurweb_RPC_interface</a>.
module Web.ArchLinux.API

-- | A wrapper of <a>ClientM</a>, with <a>BaseUrl</a> reflected to type
--   level phantom <a>APIType</a>.
newtype APIClient (k :: APIType) a
APIClient :: ClientM a -> APIClient (k :: APIType) a
[unWrapClientM] :: APIClient (k :: APIType) a -> ClientM a

-- | Two types of APIs.
data APIType
ArchLinux :: APIType
Aur :: APIType

-- | Class to reify <a>BaseUrl</a> from <a>APIType</a>.
class HasBaseUrl (k :: APIType)
getBaseUrl :: HasBaseUrl k => BaseUrl

-- | Runs <a>APIClient</a>.
--   
--   It calls <a>getBaseUrl</a>, then creates <a>ClientEnv</a>, finally
--   calls <a>runClientM</a>.
runAPIClient :: forall (s :: APIType) a. HasBaseUrl s => Manager -> APIClient s a -> IO (Either ClientError a)

-- | Like <a>runAPIClient</a>, but creates a <a>Manager</a>.
runAPIClient' :: forall (s :: APIType) a. HasBaseUrl s => APIClient s a -> IO (Either ClientError a)

-- | Options available in searching packages in Arch Linux official
--   repositories.
--   
--   See <a>searchPackage</a>.
data SearchOptions
SearchOptions :: Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> [Repo] -> [Arch] -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Flagged -> SearchOptions
[_nameOrDescription] :: SearchOptions -> Maybe Text
[_exactName] :: SearchOptions -> Maybe Text
[_targetDescription] :: SearchOptions -> Maybe Text
[_targetRepositories] :: SearchOptions -> [Repo]
[_targetArchitectures] :: SearchOptions -> [Arch]
[_targetMaintianer] :: SearchOptions -> Maybe Text
[_targetPackager] :: SearchOptions -> Maybe Text
[_isFlagged] :: SearchOptions -> Maybe Flagged

-- | An empty options value for convenient.
--   
--   For example,
--   
--   <pre>
--   let options =
--         emptySearchOptions
--           &amp; nameOrDescription ?~ "kea"
--           &amp; targetRepositories .~ [Extra, ExtraTesting]
--   searchPackage options
--   </pre>
--   
--   searchs packages whose names or descriptions contain <tt>kea</tt>,
--   from <tt>Extra</tt> or <tt>Extra-Testing</tt>.
emptySearchOptions :: SearchOptions

-- | Gets details of an exact package.
getPackageDetails :: Repo -> Arch -> Text -> APIClient 'ArchLinux PackageInformation

-- | Gets files list of an exact package.
getPackageFiles :: Repo -> Arch -> Text -> APIClient 'ArchLinux PackageFiles

-- | Searches packages.
--   
--   See <a>SearchOptions</a> and <a>emptySearchOptions</a>.
searchPackage :: SearchOptions -> APIClient 'ArchLinux (ArchLinuxResponse PackageInformation)

-- | Searches packages in AUR by what?
data AurSearchType
ByName :: AurSearchType
ByNameOrDesc :: AurSearchType
ByMaintainer :: AurSearchType
ByDepends :: AurSearchType
ByMakedepends :: AurSearchType
ByOptdepends :: AurSearchType
ByCheckdepends :: AurSearchType

-- | Searches packages in AUR.
searchAur :: AurSearchType -> Text -> APIClient 'Aur (AurResponse [AurSearch])

-- | Gets details of a set of packages in AUR.
getAurInfo :: [Text] -> APIClient 'Aur (AurResponse [AurInfo])
instance GHC.Base.Applicative (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance GHC.Enum.Enum Web.ArchLinux.API.AurSearchType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Web.ArchLinux.API.AurSearchType
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Web.ArchLinux.API.SearchOptions
instance GHC.Base.Functor (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance GHC.Generics.Generic (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k a)
instance GHC.Generics.Generic Web.ArchLinux.API.AurSearchType
instance GHC.Generics.Generic Web.ArchLinux.API.SearchOptions
instance Web.ArchLinux.API.HasBaseUrl 'Web.ArchLinux.API.ArchLinux
instance Web.ArchLinux.API.HasBaseUrl 'Web.ArchLinux.API.Aur
instance GHC.Base.Monad (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance Control.Monad.Catch.MonadCatch (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance Control.Monad.Error.Class.MonadError Servant.Client.Core.ClientError.ClientError (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance Control.Monad.IO.Class.MonadIO (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance Control.Monad.Reader.Class.MonadReader Servant.Client.Internal.HttpClient.ClientEnv (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance Control.Monad.Catch.MonadThrow (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Web.ArchLinux.API.AurSearchType
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Web.ArchLinux.API.SearchOptions
instance Servant.Client.Core.RunClient.RunClient (Web.ArchLinux.API.APIClient k)
instance GHC.Show.Show Web.ArchLinux.API.AurSearchType
instance GHC.Show.Show Web.ArchLinux.API.SearchOptions


-- | Arch Linux official repositories web interfaces and AUR web
--   interfaces.
module Web.ArchLinux
